import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.drop_duplicates().copy()
    # Convert body mass from text (handles commas) to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', ''),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    # Keep only valid body mass values per the rules
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)].copy()
    # Standardize sex labels to fix case variants
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.lower().replace('nan', pd.NA)
    # Convert flipper length to numeric and mark invalid values as missing
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['flipper_length_mm'].astype(str).str.replace(',', ''),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    df.loc[
        (df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235),
        'flipper_length_mm'
    ] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    cleaned = clean(df)
    cleaned = cleaned.dropna(subset=['species'])
    avg = cleaned.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): round(float(v), 2) for k, v in avg.items()}
